tasks.title: Prepare initial-route acceptance and exact publication batch
tasks.goal: Produce the complete reviewable acceptance/effect package before requesting actual publication approval.
steps: Join independent initial-route acceptance evidence from M-12-A/B and all mandatory prerequisites; identify optional/incomplete future scope explicitly.
Build the exact local publication plan using M-07: source/lock/captures, all bundles, targets, replaced remote assets, effective smoke policy, producer trust and recoverability.
Recheck current own 1.0.0/Redbook decisions and B-ready isolated tests without enabling B; deliver one digest-bound batch for current-A approval.
positive_cases: A complete initial-route subject has all mandatory local proof and exact planned effects.
A deliberately explicit smoke skip is preserved as skipped policy.
negative_cases: Missing initial evidence, changed capture or unsupported mandatory feature prevents readiness.
Neither M-15 nor M-17-D is marked complete by this package.
checks: SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: xtask target/cases are TO BIND from source/metadata to affected positive/negative obligations; choose --lib, --test <name>, --bin <name>, or affected --doc before compiling.

RUN BOUND CHECKS: after binding, use cargo test -p xtask <target> <case> -- --exact for lib/test/bin, or a reviewed small family without --exact; bind supported rustdoc selection separately. Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.

acceptance: The batch is concrete enough to authorize without further implementation design.
No public writes occurred; pending owner batch decision remains a separate unresolved action.
tasks.safe_stop: Ready-to-approve local batch is a safe stop, not completed publication.
tasks.commit_subject: docs(release): prepare exact initial-route publication evidence
notes: target/next-publication is a proposed local artifact directory. Source tests and artifact smoke claims require actual evidence; producer success is not acceptance.

tasks.title: Execute and verify the approved publication batch
tasks.goal: Only after the exact current-A approval, apply the batch and independently verify its declared publication/smoke outcome.
steps: Resolve the exact approved batch digest and targets; if approval is absent, declined or superseded, stop with publication still pending.
Invoke the implemented M-07 apply path with immediate authority/source/remote-state revalidation; follow only its approved effects and retained recovery plan.

Inspect resulting external assets/metadata and execute the batch's declared installed-artifact smoke policy; retain receipts or exact partial/recovery status, then report only the initial-route result.
positive_cases: The unchanged approved batch publishes exactly its prepared subject.
Verified receipts and passed/skipped smoke policy match independent observations.
negative_cases: Changed remote generation, policy, capture or approval requires a new plan rather than silent continuation.
Partial effects or pending approval never become done; live B remains disabled.

Final publication status is executed/verified or explicit partial/pending, separate from local readiness and expanded programme completion.
tasks.safe_stop: Without approval: preserve the ready plan and stop. After approved effects: retain verified or recovery-required evidence.
tasks.commit_subject: docs(release): record approved initial publication outcomes
notes: This authored task is not approval for any remote destination. Root binds the actual publication commands/endpoints and authority receipt from .1; no guessed release/registry commands.
Local write_paths describe evidence/artifacts only. Remote authority comes solely from the exact approved batch; no messages to unrelated people/services.
